question: Will Jensen Huang deliver the keynote at Nvidia GTC Washington, D.C. before December 4, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO and board member effective immediately on Nov 12, 2026, after an internal investigation into his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Huang has been summoned to testify before Congress. The GTC DC keynote page still lists Huang for Dec 1, but a Nov 12 article says that listing pre-dates his resignation, and I found no Nvidia reconfirmation. Ian Buck is listed as a Dec 1 keynote speaker. The fine print allows remote or recorded delivery, but a just-ousted executive under a national-security cloud giving Nvidia's flagship DC keynote is very unlikely. Polymarket prices his rejoining Nvidia at ~3% by Nov 30 and ~8% by Dec 31; those are near-miss contracts, used only as a ceiling on a reversal. No direct market found.
calls.dossier:
- Nov 12, 2026 (NPR, Al Jazeera, Fox Business, SEC 8-K 'NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition'): Jensen Huang stepped down as president, CEO and board member effective immediately, after an internal investigation into his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy (Alice Huang / Megaspeed links). CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; Harvey Jones was named board chair.
- CNN live news (Nov 11-12): Huang was summoned to testify before Congress after resigning.
- The National News, Nov 10 (before the resignation): Huang was still scheduled for the GTC DC keynote as scrutiny grew.
- nvidia.com/gtc/dc/keynote (fetched Nov 17, 2026): still lists 'Speaker: Jensen Huang, Tuesday Dec 1, 2-4 p.m. ET' with no change notice. The main GTC DC page lists speakers such as Ian Buck and Dario Gil, and a search snippet names Ian Buck as a Dec 1 keynote speaker.
- eventsforgamers.com, Nov 12: says the keynote is uncertain, the front page still showed Huang's keynote, and the optics of an interim CEO or rotating VPs on stage are a challenge. No Nvidia statement on the keynote was found.
- Conference dates: Nov 30-Dec 3, 2026, Ronald Reagan Building, DC. Keynote Dec 1.
- Fine print: Huang may deliver in person, remotely, or by a recording made specifically for GTC DC, possibly alongside other speakers.
- Status quo: Huang holds no Nvidia role. The keynote page has not been updated since the resignation.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off Nvidia IR or credible reporting of Huang actually delivering the keynote, not off the event page listing.
- Event window: now -> Dec 3, 2026 (before Dec 4 EST). As of Nov 17, the keynote is 14 days away.
- Searched but not found: any official Nvidia confirmation, cancellation or replacement of the Huang keynote after Nov 12, and any reporting on Huang's intentions about GTC DC.
- Related markets exist for Huang rejoining Nvidia by Nov 30 / Dec 31 2026; these are not this contract.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the key facts: the Nov 12 resignation and 8-K, Kress as interim CEO, the board not considering a return, a stale keynote page, congressional testimony, and rejoin markets at ~3%/8%. The one factual difference is whether the main GTC DC page names Ian Buck or no keynote speaker. I couldn't settle it without web access, and it doesn't matter because neither version confirms Huang. The rest is judgment about tail scenarios (reinstatement, recorded address). The rejoin markets bound those near 3%, and rejoining is necessary-ish but not sufficient, so I keep 2%.
